verses.original: וַיְהִ֡י בִּימֵ֣י אָ֠חָז בֶּן־ יוֹתָ֨ם בֶּן־ עֻזִּיָּ֜הוּ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֗ה עָלָ֣ה רְצִ֣ין מֶֽלֶךְ־ אֲ֠רָם וּפֶ֨קַח בֶּן־ רְמַלְיָ֤הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם לַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה עָלֶ֑יהָ וְלֹ֥א יָכֹ֖ל לְהִלָּחֵ֥ם עָלֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî bî·mê ’ā·ḥāz ben- yō·w·ṯām ben- ‘uz·zî·yā·hū me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh ‘ā·lāh rə·ṣîn me·leḵ- ’ă·rām ū·p̄e·qaḥ ben- rə·mal·yā·hū me·leḵ- yiś·rā·’êl yə·rū·šā·lim lam·mil·ḥā·māh ‘ā·le·hā wə·lō yā·ḵōl lə·hil·lā·ḥêm ‘ā·le·hā
verses.literal: Now in the days that Ahaz son of Jotham the son of Uzziah was king of Judah Rezin king of Aram marched up to wage war against Jerusalem He was accompanied by Pekah son of Remaliah the king of Israel but he could not overpower the city
verses.literalPt: Nos dias de Acaz, filho de Jotão, filho de Uzias, rei de Judá, subiu Rezim, rei da Síria, com Peca, filho de Remalias, rei de Israel, a Jerusalém para pelejar contra ela; e não podia prevalecer contra ela.

verses.original: וַיֻּגַּ֗ד לְבֵ֤ית דָּוִד֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר נָ֥חָֽה אֲרָ֖ם עַל־ אֶפְרָ֑יִם וַיָּ֤נַע לְבָבוֹ֙ וּלְבַ֣ב עַמּ֔וֹ כְּנ֥וֹעַ עֲצֵי־ יַ֖עַר מִפְּנֵי־ רֽוּחַ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yug·gaḏ lə·ḇêṯ dā·wiḏ lê·mōr nā·ḥāh ’ă·rām ‘al- ’ep̄·rā·yim way·yā·na‘ lə·ḇā·ḇōw ū·lə·ḇaḇ ‘am·mōw kə·nō·w·a‘ ‘ă·ṣê- ya·‘ar mip·pə·nê- rū·aḥ
verses.literal: When it was reported to the house of David . . . that Aram . . . was in league with Ephraim the hearts of Ahaz and his people trembled like trees in the forest . . . shaken by the wind
verses.literalPt: Aviso foi dado à casa de Davi, dizendo: A Síria está aliada com Efraim. Foi agitado o coração de Acaz e o coração do seu povo, como se agitam as árvores do bosque à força do vento.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָה֮ אֶֽל־ יְשַׁעְיָהוּ֒ צֵא־ נָא֙ לִקְרַ֣את אָחָ֔ז אַתָּ֕ה וּשְׁאָ֖ר יָשׁ֣וּב בְּנֶ֑ךָ אֶל־ קְצֵ֗ה תְּעָלַת֙ הַבְּרֵכָ֣ה הָעֶלְיוֹנָ֔ה אֶל־ מְסִלַּ֖ת שְׂדֵ֥ה כוֹבֵֽס׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- yə·ša‘·yā·hū ṣê- nā liq·raṯ ’ā·ḥāz ’at·tāh ū·šə·’ār yā·šūḇ bə·ne·ḵā ’el- qə·ṣêh tə·‘ā·laṯ hab·bə·rê·ḵāh hā·‘el·yō·w·nāh ’el- mə·sil·laṯ śə·ḏêh ḵō·w·ḇês
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Isaiah Go out . . . with your son Shear-jashub to meet Ahaz . . . at the end of the aqueduct that feeds the upper pool on the road to the Launderer’s Field
verses.literalPt: Disse Jeová a Isaías: Sai, agora, ao encontro de Acaz, tu e teu filho Sear-Jasube, junto ao fim do aqueduto da piscina superior, na estrada do campo do lavandeiro;

verses.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֵ֠לָיו הִשָּׁמֵ֨ר וְהַשְׁקֵ֜ט אַל־ תִּירָ֗א וּלְבָבְךָ֙ אַל־ יֵרַ֔ךְ מִשְּׁנֵ֨י זַנְב֧וֹת הָאוּדִ֛ים הָעֲשֵׁנִ֖ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה בָּחֳרִי־ אַ֛ף רְצִ֥ין וַאֲרָ֖ם וּבֶן־ רְמַלְיָֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ê·lāw hiš·šā·mêr wə·haš·qêṭ ’al- tî·rā ū·lə·ḇā·ḇə·ḵā ’al- yê·raḵ miš·šə·nê zan·ḇō·wṯ hā·’ū·ḏîm hā·‘ă·šê·nîm hā·’êl·leh bā·ḥo·rî- ’ap̄ rə·ṣîn wa·’ă·rām ū·ḇen- rə·mal·yā·hū
verses.literal: and say to him Calm down and be quiet Do not be afraid or disheartened . . . . . . over these two smoldering stubs of firewood over the fierce anger of Rezin and Aram and of the son of Remaliah
verses.literalPt: e dize-lhe: Guarda-te e conserva-te tranquilo; não temas, nem te desfaleça o coração por causa destes dois restos de tições fumegantes, por causa do ardor da ira de Rezim e Síria e do filho de Remalias.

verses.original: יַ֗עַן כִּֽי־ יָעַ֥ץ עָלֶ֛יךָ אֲרָ֖ם רָעָ֑ה אֶפְרַ֥יִם וּבֶן־ רְמַלְיָ֖הוּ לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ya·‘an kî- yā·‘aṣ ‘ā·le·ḵā ’ă·rām rā·‘āh ’ep̄·ra·yim ū·ḇen- rə·mal·yā·hū lê·mōr
verses.literal: For . . . Aram along with Ephraim and the son of Remaliah has plotted your ruin . . . saying
verses.literalPt: Porquanto a Síria resolveu fazer-te mal, bem como Efraim e o filho de Remalias, dizendo:

verses.original: נַעֲלֶ֤ה בִֽיהוּדָה֙ וּנְקִיצֶ֔נָּה וְנַבְקִעֶ֖נָּה אֵלֵ֑ינוּ וְנַמְלִ֥יךְ מֶ֙לֶךְ֙ בְּתוֹכָ֔הּ אֵ֖ת בֶּן־ טָֽבְאַֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: na·‘ă·leh ḇî·hū·ḏāh ū·nə·qî·ṣen·nāh wə·naḇ·qi·‘en·nāh ’ê·lê·nū wə·nam·lîḵ me·leḵ bə·ṯō·w·ḵāh ’êṯ ben- ṭā·ḇə·’al
verses.literal: Let us invade Judah terrorize it and divide it among ourselves Then we can install the son of Tabeal over it as king
verses.literalPt: Subamos contra Judá, e amedrontemo-lo, e demos sobre ele, e tomemo-lo para nós, e façamos reinar no meio dele o filho de Tabeel;

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה לֹ֥א תָק֖וּם וְלֹ֥א תִֽהְיֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh lō ṯā·qūm wə·lō ṯih·yeh
verses.literal: But this is what the Lord GOD says It will not arise it will not happen
verses.literalPt: por isso, diz o Senhor Jeová: Isso não subsistirá, nem acontecerá.

verses.original: כִּ֣י רֹ֤אשׁ אֲרָם֙ דַּמֶּ֔שֶׂק וְרֹ֥אשׁ דַּמֶּ֖שֶׂק רְצִ֑ין וּבְע֗וֹד שִׁשִּׁ֤ים וְחָמֵשׁ֙ שָׁנָ֔ה יֵחַ֥ת אֶפְרַ֖יִם מֵעָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî rōš ’ă·rām dam·me·śeq wə·rōš dam·me·śeq rə·ṣîn ū·ḇə·‘ō·wḏ šiš·šîm wə·ḥā·mêš šā·nāh yê·ḥaṯ ’ep̄·ra·yim mê·‘ām
verses.literal: For the head of Aram is Damascus and the head of Damascus is Rezin Within sixty-five . . . years Ephraim will be shattered as a people
verses.literalPt: Pois a capital da Síria é Damasco, e o cabeça de Damasco é Rezim (e, dentro de sessenta e cinco anos, Efraim será despedaçado, de modo que deixe de ser povo);

verses.original: וְרֹ֤אשׁ אֶפְרַ֙יִם֙ שֹׁמְר֔וֹן וְרֹ֥אשׁ שֹׁמְר֖וֹן בֶּן־ רְמַלְיָ֑הוּ אִ֚ם לֹ֣א תַאֲמִ֔ינוּ כִּ֖י לֹ֥א תֵאָמֵֽנוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·rōš ’ep̄·ra·yim šō·mə·rō·wn wə·rōš šō·mə·rō·wn ben- rə·mal·yā·hū ’im lō ṯa·’ă·mî·nū kî lō ṯê·’ā·mê·nū
verses.literal: The head of Ephraim is Samaria and the head of Samaria is the son of Remaliah If you do not stand firm in your faith then you will not stand at all
verses.literalPt: e a capital de Efraim é Samaria, e o cabeça de Samaria é o filho de Remalias. Se o não crerdes, não haveis de permanecer.

verses.original: וַיּ֣וֹסֶף יְהוָ֔ה דַּבֵּ֥ר אֶל־ אָחָ֖ז לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·w·sep̄ Yah·weh dab·bêr ’el- ’ā·ḥāz lê·mōr
verses.literal: Again the LORD spoke to Ahaz saying
verses.literalPt: De novo, falou Jeová com Acaz:

verses.original: שְׁאַל־ לְךָ֣ א֔וֹת מֵעִ֖ם יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ הַעְמֵ֣ק שְׁאָ֔לָה א֖וֹ הַגְבֵּ֥הַּ לְמָֽעְלָה׃
verses.transliteration: šə·’al- lə·ḵā ’ō·wṯ mê·‘im Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ha‘·mêq šə·’ā·lāh ’ōw haḡ·bê·ah lə·mā·‘ə·lāh
verses.literal: Ask for a sign from the LORD your God whether from the depths of Sheol or the heights of heaven
verses.literalPt: Pede a Jeová, teu Deus, um sinal embaixo nas profundezas, ou em cima, nas alturas.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אָחָ֑ז לֹא־ אֶשְׁאַ֥ל וְלֹֽא־ אֲנַסֶּ֖ה אֶת־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ā·ḥāz lō- ’eš·’al wə·lō- ’ă·nas·seh ’eṯ- Yah·weh
verses.literal: But Ahaz replied I will not ask I will not test the LORD
verses.literalPt: Respondeu, porém, Acaz: Não pedirei, nem tentarei a Jeová.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר שִׁמְעוּ־ נָ֖א בֵּ֣ית דָּוִ֑ד הַמְעַ֤ט מִכֶּם֙ הַלְא֣וֹת אֲנָשִׁ֔ים כִּ֥י תַלְא֖וּ גַּ֥ם אֶת־ אֱלֹהָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer šim·‘ū- nā bêṯ dā·wiḏ ham·‘aṭ mik·kem hal·’ō·wṯ ’ă·nā·šîm kî ṯal·’ū gam ’eṯ- ’ĕ·lō·hāy
verses.literal: Then Isaiah said Hear now O house of David Is it not enough to try the patience of men . . . Will you try the patience of my God as well
verses.literalPt: Disse Isaías: Ouvi, agora, ó casa de Davi; porventura, não vos basta fatigardes aos homens, mas ainda fatigais também ao meu Deus?

verses.original: לָ֠כֵן יִתֵּ֨ן אֲדֹנָ֥י ה֛וּא לָכֶ֖ם א֑וֹת הִנֵּ֣ה הָעַלְמָ֗ה הָרָה֙ וְיֹלֶ֣דֶת בֵּ֔ן וְקָרָ֥את שְׁמ֖וֹ עִמָּ֥נוּ אֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên yit·tên ’ă·ḏō·nāy hū lā·ḵem ’ō·wṯ hin·nêh hā·‘al·māh hā·rāh wə·yō·le·ḏeṯ bên wə·qā·rāṯ šə·mōw ‘im·mā·nū ’êl
verses.literal: Therefore the Lord Himself will give you a sign Behold the virgin will be with child and give birth to a son and will call Him Immanuel
verses.literalPt: Portanto, o Senhor mesmo vos dará um sinal; eis que uma donzela conceberá, e dará à luz um filho, e por-lhe-á o nome de Emanuel.

verses.original: חֶמְאָ֥ה וּדְבַ֖שׁ יֹאכֵ֑ל לְדַעְתּ֛וֹ מָא֥וֹס בָּרָ֖ע וּבָח֥וֹר בַּטּֽוֹב׃
verses.transliteration: ḥem·’āh ū·ḏə·ḇaš yō·ḵêl lə·ḏa‘·tōw mā·’ō·ws bā·rā‘ ū·ḇā·ḥō·wr baṭ·ṭō·wḇ
verses.literal: By the time He knows enough to reject evil and choose good He will be eating curds and honey
verses.literalPt: Ele comerá manteiga e mel, quando souber rejeitar o mal e escolher o bem.

verses.original: כִּ֠י בְּטֶ֨רֶם יֵדַ֥ע הַנַּ֛עַר מָאֹ֥ס בָּרָ֖ע וּבָחֹ֣ר בַּטּ֑וֹב תֵּעָזֵ֤ב הָאֲדָמָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אַתָּ֣ה קָ֔ץ מִפְּנֵ֖י שְׁנֵ֥י מְלָכֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: kî bə·ṭe·rem yê·ḏa‘ han·na·‘ar mā·’ōs bā·rā‘ ū·ḇā·ḥōr baṭ·ṭō·wḇ tê·‘ā·zêḇ hā·’ă·ḏā·māh ’ă·šer ’at·tāh qāṣ mip·pə·nê šə·nê mə·lā·ḵe·hā
verses.literal: For before the boy knows enough to reject evil and choose good the land of the two kings you dread . . . will be laid waste
verses.literalPt: Pois, antes que o menino saiba rejeitar o mal e escolher o bem, será desolada a terra, ante cujos dois reis tu tremes de medo.

verses.original: יָבִ֨יא יְהוָ֜ה עָלֶ֗יךָ וְעַֽל־ עַמְּךָ֮ וְעַל־ בֵּ֣ית אָבִיךָ֒ יָמִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־ בָ֔אוּ לְמִיּ֥וֹם סוּר־ אֶפְרַ֖יִם מֵעַ֣ל יְהוּדָ֑ה אֵ֖ת מֶ֥לֶךְ אַשּֽׁוּר׃פ
verses.transliteration: yā·ḇî Yah·weh ‘ā·le·ḵā wə·‘al- ‘am·mə·ḵā wə·‘al- bêṯ ’ā·ḇî·ḵā yā·mîm ’ă·šer lō- ḇā·’ū lə·mî·yō·wm sūr- ’ep̄·ra·yim mê·‘al yə·hū·ḏāh ’êṯ me·leḵ ’aš·šūr
verses.literal: The LORD will bring on you and on your people and on the house of your father a time unlike . . . any since the day Ephraim . . . separated from Judah He will bring the king of Assyria
verses.literalPt: Jeová fará vir sobre ti, sobre o teu povo e sobre a casa de teu pai dias quais não têm vindo desde que Efraim se retirou de Judá — a saber, o rei da Assíria.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה׀ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יִשְׁרֹ֤ק יְהוָה֙ לַזְּב֔וּב אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּקְצֵ֖ה יְאֹרֵ֣י מִצְרָ֑יִם וְלַ֨דְּבוֹרָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּאֶ֥רֶץ אַשּֽׁוּר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh bay·yō·wm ha·hū yiš·rōq Yah·weh laz·zə·ḇūḇ ’ă·šer biq·ṣêh yə·’ō·rê miṣ·rā·yim wə·lad·də·ḇō·w·rāh ’ă·šer bə·’e·reṣ ’aš·šūr
verses.literal: On that day the LORD will whistle to the flies at the farthest streams of the Nile and to the bees in the land of Assyria
verses.literalPt: Naquele dia, acontecerá que Jeová assobiará às moscas que estão no extremo dos rios do Egito e às abelhas que estão na terra da Assíria.

verses.original: וּבָ֨אוּ וְנָח֤וּ כֻלָּם֙ בְּנַחֲלֵ֣י הַבַּתּ֔וֹת וּבִנְקִיקֵ֖י הַסְּלָעִ֑ים וּבְכֹל֙ הַנַּ֣עֲצוּצִ֔ים וּבְכֹ֖ל הַנַּהֲלֹלִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇā·’ū wə·nā·ḥū ḵul·lām bə·na·ḥă·lê hab·bat·tō·wṯ ū·ḇin·qî·qê has·sə·lā·‘îm ū·ḇə·ḵōl han·na·‘ă·ṣū·ṣîm ū·ḇə·ḵōl han·na·hă·lō·lîm
verses.literal: And they will all come and settle in the steep ravines and clefts of the rocks in all the thornbushes and watering holes
verses.literalPt: Elas virão e pousarão todas nos vales desolados, e nas fendas dos rochedos, e sobre todos os pastos.

verses.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֡וּא יְגַלַּ֣ח אֲדֹנָי֩ בְּתַ֨עַר הַשְּׂכִירָ֜ה בְּעֶבְרֵ֤י נָהָר֙ בְּמֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר אֶת־ הָרֹ֖אשׁ וְשַׂ֣עַר הָרַגְלָ֑יִם וְגַ֥ם אֶת־ הַזָּקָ֖ן תִּסְפֶּֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: bay·yō·wm ha·hū yə·ḡal·laḥ ’ă·ḏō·nāy bə·ṯa·‘ar haś·śə·ḵî·rāh bə·‘eḇ·rê nā·hār bə·me·leḵ ’aš·šūr ’eṯ- hā·rōš wə·śa·‘ar hā·raḡ·lā·yim wə·ḡam ’eṯ- haz·zā·qān tis·peh
verses.literal: On that day the Lord will use a razor hired from beyond the Euphrates the king of Assyria to shave your head and the hair of your legs and to remove your beard as well
verses.literalPt: Naquele dia, rapará o Senhor com uma navalha alugada, que está nas regiões além do rio, a saber, com o rei da Assíria, a cabeça e os cabelos dos pés; também ela tirará a barba.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֖ה בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא יְחַיֶּה־ אִ֛ישׁ עֶגְלַ֥ת בָּקָ֖ר וּשְׁתֵּי־ צֹֽאן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh bay·yō·wm ha·hū yə·ḥay·yeh- ’îš ‘eḡ·laṯ bā·qār ū·šə·tê- ṣōn
verses.literal: On that day a man will raise a young cow . . . and two sheep
verses.literalPt: Sucederá, naquele dia, que um homem criará uma vaca nova e duas ovelhas;

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה מֵרֹ֛ב עֲשׂ֥וֹת חָלָ֖ב יֹאכַ֣ל חֶמְאָ֑ה כִּֽי־ חֶמְאָ֤ה וּדְבַשׁ֙ יֹאכֵ֔ל כָּל־ הַנּוֹתָ֖ר בְּקֶ֥רֶב הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh mê·rōḇ ‘ă·śō·wṯ ḥā·lāḇ yō·ḵal ḥem·’āh kî- ḥem·’āh ū·ḏə·ḇaš yō·ḵêl kāl- han·nō·w·ṯār bə·qe·reḇ hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: and from the abundance of milk they give he will eat curds for all who remain in the land will eat curds and honey
verses.literalPt: e, por causa da abundância do leite que lhe derem, comerá manteiga. Pois todo aquele que for deixado no meio da terra comerá manteiga e mel.

verses.original: וְהָיָה֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא יִֽהְיֶ֣ה כָל־ מָק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֧ר יִֽהְיֶה־ שָּׁ֛ם אֶ֥לֶף גֶּ֖פֶן בְּאֶ֣לֶף כָּ֑סֶף לַשָּׁמִ֥יר וְלַשַּׁ֖יִת יִֽהְיֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh bay·yō·wm ha·hū yih·yeh ḵāl mā·qō·wm ’ă·šer yih·yeh- šām ’e·lep̄ ge·p̄en bə·’e·lep̄ kā·sep̄ laš·šā·mîr wə·laš·ša·yiṯ yih·yeh
verses.literal: And on that day - in every place that had . . . a thousand vines worth a thousand shekels of silver only briers and thorns will be found
verses.literalPt: Naquele dia, todo lugar em que antes havia mil vides do valor de mil moedas de prata será entregue aos espinhos e abrolhos.

verses.original: בַּחִצִּ֥ים וּבַקֶּ֖שֶׁת יָ֣בוֹא שָׁ֑מָּה כִּי־ שָׁמִ֥יר וָשַׁ֖יִת תִּֽהְיֶ֥ה כָל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: ba·ḥiṣ·ṣîm ū·ḇaq·qe·šeṯ yā·ḇō·w šām·māh kî- šā·mîr wā·ša·yiṯ tih·yeh ḵāl hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Men will go there with bow and arrow for the land will be covered with briers and thorns
verses.literalPt: Com setas e arco, entrarão ali, porque toda a terra será espinhos e abrolhos.

verses.original: וְכֹ֣ל הֶהָרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר בַּמַּעְדֵּר֙ יֵעָ֣דֵר֔וּן לֹֽא־ תָב֣וֹא שָׁ֔מָּה יִרְאַ֖ת שָׁמִ֣יר וָשָׁ֑יִת וְהָיָה֙ לְמִשְׁלַ֣ח שׁ֔וֹר וּלְמִרְמַ֖ס שֶֽׂה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵōl he·hā·rîm ’ă·šer bam·ma‘·dêr yê·‘ā·ḏê·rūn lō- ṯā·ḇō·w šām·māh yir·’aṯ šā·mîr wā·šā·yiṯ wə·hā·yāh lə·miš·laḥ šō·wr ū·lə·mir·mas śeh
verses.literal: For fear of the briers and thorns you will no longer traverse the hills once tilled . . . by the hoe they will become places for oxen to graze and sheep to trample
verses.literalPt: Quanto a todos os outeiros que, com enxada, se revolviam, para ali não chegarás com medo dos espinhos e abrolhos, mas servirão de lugar para soltar bois e para ser pisado do gado miúdo.
